nodes.name: Stage 1 — discover
nodes.notes: Fetches every enabled source and company board, normalises, dedupes, applies the Stage 2a rules filter. Writes jobs/*.yaml.

nodes.name: Stage 2b/2c — rank
nodes.notes: Set llm:true once OPENROUTER_API_KEY is in the bridge process environment. 2b runs either way.

nodes.name: Send digest
nodes.notes: Swap for the Telegram node if you prefer inline buttons — the resume URLs work the same way.

nodes.name: GATE 1 — you decide
nodes.notes: Execution pauses here indefinitely. Each pursue/skip link in the email resumes it with the slug and verdict in the query string.

nodes.name: Stage 3 — tailor CV
nodes.notes: Only runs on a pursue. Produces the tailored CV plus its six checks.

nodes.name: Stage 4 — letter draft
nodes.notes: Produces the draft with the opening left as a TODO block. GATE 3 is offline: you write those two sentences by hand.
